summary: Lando Norris converted pole position into McLaren's first victory of the season at the Hungaroring, holding off sustained pressure through a race that hinged on tire strategy and pit-stop execution. The dramatic qualifying session set up a compelling contest, with Norris managing his tires expertly through the final stint to secure the win ahead of his rivals. The victory narrows McLaren's gap in the constructors' championship and marks a significant turning point after a season of inconsistent results.
